added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own arms, baseline_suite log gate_base.log and after_suite log gate_head2.log. Base failures across the completed files: tests/test_reduced_newton_termination.py::test_last_permitted_trip_reports_the_arrived_iterate. Head failures: that id plus tests/test_forward_solve_request.py::test_default_request_schema_resolves_from_the_installed_version_table. tests/test_equilibrium_forward_solve.py was cut at EXIT=124 on both arms so it contributes no ids; the run's separate h200/titan rerun of that file reports the same two ids on both arms (h200_base.log, h200_head.log: two failed, twenty-eight passed), so no added failure is attributed to it.

findings.text: the diff adds attempted_newton_promotions and accepted_newton_promotions to ForwardSolveReceipt (nova/equilibrium/solve_request.py:742-743) without updating the pinned RECEIPT_FIELDS tuple at tests/test_forward_solve_request.py:52, so test_default_request_schema_resolves_from_the_installed_version_table fails at head (gate_head2.log:73-74, one failed and four passed) and passed at base (gate_base.log:50-51, five passed): a real added failure in one of the five files the done-when requires to stay green, in a file outside the node's write fence, which should have been a blocker or an outside_scope entry rather than a complete record.

the reviewed manifest's after_suite and baseline_suite entries both set completed: true and carry one failure id, but the logs they name end tests/test_equilibrium_forward_solve.py with EXIT=124 (gate_head2.log:78, gate_base.log:56) and gate_head2.log:73-74 holds a second head failure the record omits, so the gate receipt claims a completeness and a failure set its own log does not support.

the reduced route still ends its own active-set loop on a zero mask difference with FixedPointTerminationReason.ACTIVE_SET_SETTLED while nova/equilibrium/fixed_point.py:4850-4853 now requires an attempted-and-refused promotion before settlement ends the solve, so the two routes disagree about what a settled mask means and the new vocabulary reaches only one of them.

test_forward_receipt_publishes_the_promotion_counts asserts only that the two field names exist on the dataclass, so the nova/equilibrium/forward.py:2389-2395 threading that populates them can be reverted without reddening any test, and the negative control recorded at negative_control.log reddened only the pure-predicate case while the four loop-level tests passed.
the frame 44 limited table row opens with an extra empty cell, shifting every value in that row one column right against the header row.

the base heavy-file arm's header names SOURCE_REVISION=cdf606e39453b0aa143ec3e674fa12c164210255, which resolves to no object in this repository and is the empty scratch-base marker commit in base-tree, so that arm cannot be tied to 6f20bafbc, and the log omits the module.__file__ and resolved working directory the manifest contract requires of a scratch-tree arm.

justifications.fit: nova/equilibrium/fixed_point.py:369-419 follows the surrounding jnp.where reason-mapping idiom and the added names (active_set_settles_as_stall, active_set_stop_reason, ACTIVE_SET_STATIONARY, ACTIVE_SET_STEP_REFUSED) carry no plan, ticket or version label; the only blemish is the reassignment of the name reason at fixed_point.py:5064 and :5075.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/fixed_point.py:4850-4853 makes a settled mask continue the loop until a promotion is attempted, and nova/equilibrium/fixed_point.py:389-419 separates ACTIVE_SET_STATIONARY (11) from ACTIVE_SET_STEP_REFUSED (12) with converged false, so a settled mask above tolerance no longer ends the solve as converged; the measurement half of the done-when is weaker, because scripts/prototypes/diiid_forward_convergence/run_probe_frames.py never calls host_boundary_read, so the per-arm bounding class the done-when requires is replaced in the evidence fragment by achieved_class against the requested class.
justifications.reuse: the search for a second owner of active-set stop-reason mapping found only the simple inline nonfinite/converged mapping blocks at nova/equilibrium/fixed_point.py:3969 and :3357, which this extends rather than duplicates, but nova/equilibrium/reduced_newton.py:1573-1580 still ends its own loop on a zero mask difference with ACTIVE_SET_SETTLED, so the same capability now has two owners that disagree.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff 6f20bafbc..da9c18d8f touches only the seven declared write paths, but the committed receipt fields break tests/test_forward_solve_request.py:139, which is outside the fence, and the manifest reports neither a blocker nor an outside_scope entry for it.
